angularDiameterSource: Not measured: computed here from the radius and distance, 2 x 462,640.5 km at 87.15 pc = 0.0710 mas. No interferometric diameter of WASP-43 is published; the disc is far below any interferometer's resolution.
distanceSource: Gaia EDR3 parallax 11.474 +/- 0.016 mas via SIMBAD (2020yCat.1350....0G): 1000/11.474 = 87.15 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: 0.665 solar radii (462,640.5 km at 695,700 km per solar radius), the stellar radius Challener et al. (2024, ApJL 969, L32; arXiv:2406.10207, Table 1) assume for their WASP-43b eclipse map, matching Hammond et al. (2024). A model-dependent value, not an interferometric measurement.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from the Gaia DR3 photometric temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json), because no image of the photosphere exists (see investigations.json). A star's limb is not a sharp surface.
